work-productivity-proactive-agent-workflow-helper 0.1.0 — initial release

- Provides proactive agent workflow support for users seeking improved reliability, safety, and bug fixes in Agent-style tasks on Clawhub.
- Delivers practical checklists, templates, and validated work plans tailored to common job requirements.
- Incorporates robust demand validation based on 12 signals from 4 source families.
- Designed for local-hardware friendly use: favors scripts and small workflows over large cloud-only solutions.
- Includes clear output validation and guidance for next steps.
